title: Traffic Stop Anomaly
description:
You're a traffic cop on nightshift patrol along a deserted foggy road.
Another vehicle is spotted. 
Your task is clear:

Initiate sirens and pull over the vehicle.

Approach with caution. 

Wait for the window to roll down. 

Observe everything.

Don't overlook any anomalies. 

If everything appears normal, allow the driver to leave.

If an anomaly is spotted, turn back and drive away immediately.

 One mistake, and the loop resets.

 Get 8 correct decisions in a row to reach the end of your shift: 6:00 AM.

The forest closes in. 

The vehicles are never quite the same. 

Something is always watching.
 

Features• First-person psychological horror in the anomaly-spotting style

• Dozens of subtle and disturbing anomalies

• Three main game modes and a secret unlockable fourth game mode

• Slow, tense loops with addictive "one more try" gameplay

• Reset-on-error progression

• Easter eggs and secret codes accessible with the squad car laptop
description_short: You're a traffic cop on endless patrol. Pull over drivers, shine your flashlight, and spot the anomalies. Let the normal ones go... or turn back before it's too late.
